description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to mitigate the impacts of COVID-19 on the welfare of low income households and strengthen DSWD's social protection delivery systems to be adaptive and efficient.

The development objective of Beneficiary FIRST Social Protection (SP) Project for Philippines is to mitigate the impacts of Coronavirus (COVID-19) on the welfare of low income households and strengthen DSWD's social protection delivery systems to be adaptive and efficient. This project consists of three components. 1) The first component, Support for Cash Grants of the Pantawid Program, has the following sub-components: (i) Immediate COVID-19 response; and (ii) Performance-Based Condition (PBC) based support. 2) The second component, Social Protection Delivery System and Project Management, has the following sub-components: (i) SP Delivery Systems for enhanced beneficiary experience; (ii) SP Delivery Systems for the efficiency of business process and information systems; (iii) SP Delivery Systems for equity through an objective targeting mechanism; and (iv) : Project management. 3) The third component, Contingent Emergency Response, aims to allow for the reallocation of financing to provide an immediate response to an eligible crisis or emergency, as needed.

condition.narrative: Annual Work Plans and Budgets: Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.CRecurrent, Due Date: October 31 annuallyThe Borrower shallprepare and furnish to the Bank for its no-objection no later than October 31 of each year an annual work plan and budget duringtheimplementation of the Project containing relevant Project activities and expenditures proposed to be included in the Project inthe following fiscal year, including a specification of the sources of financing.

Contingent Emergency Response: Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.GIn case of an Eligible Crisis or Emergency The Borrowershall adopt a satisfactory Emergency Response Manual for Part 3 of the Project and, in the event of an eligible crisis oremergency, ensure that the activities under said part are carried out in accordance with such manual and all relevant safeguardrequirements.

Environmental and Social Standards: Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.DRecurrent, Continuous The Borrower shall ensure thatthe Project is carried out in accordance with the Environmental and Social Standards and the Environmental and Social CommitmentPlan.

Institutional Arrangements: Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.A.1Recurrent, ContinuousThe Borrower, through DSWD andthroughout the period of implementation of the Project, shall maintain Project implementation structures at the national andsub-national levels, all with composition, functions, staffing and resources satisfactory to the Bank and set out in the PantawidOperations Manual and Social Protection Delivery Systems Manual.

Mid-Term Report: Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section II.BOnce, Due date: on or about twelve (12) months after the EffectiveDateThe Borrower, through the DSWD, shall prepare and furnish to the Bank a mid-term report in form and substance acceptable tothe Bank.

PBC Monitoring and ReportingMonitoring: Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.F.1The Borrower shall engage and thereaftermaintain an Independent Verification Team to carry out independent verification of the status of achievement of PBCTargets.Reporting: Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.F.2Due Date: January 31 and July 31 on a semester basisThe Borrowershall furnish reports to the Bank on the status of achievement of the relevant PBC Targets in accordance with the verificationprotocols and procedures set out in the Social Protection Delivery Systems Manual.

Pantawid Cash Grants: Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.ERecurrent, ContinuousThe Borrower, through DSWD, shall make thePantawid Cash Grants available to the Beneficiaries in accordance with the guidelines, procedures, and criteria set forth in thePantawid Operations Manual.

Project manuals: Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.BThe Borrower, through DSWD, shall by no later than two (2) month after theEffective Date: (i) update and adopt the Pantawid Operations Manual for the implementation of the Pantawid Program; and (ii)prepare and adopt a Social Protection Delivery Systems Manual for the implementation of Parts 1.2, 2, and 3 of the Project, andensure that the Project is carried out in accordance with the arrangements and procedures set out in the manuals.

comment.narrative: The PhilSys Number (PSN) is a unique and randomly-generated 12-digit permanent identification number that is assigned to every citizen or resident alien upon successful registration to PhilSys (national ID). The PSN is tokenized as the PhilSys Card Number or PCN on the PhilID to protect the PSN from misuse and identity fraud.
